_about: What a wild spot does now and then besides a fight, by the theme of its area (mine, 2026-11-01, from Robin's list: theme events). A share of max HP or mana, gold by the tier, a flask or a card; the text is what the player reads.

meadow.text: A quiet picnic spot in the clover: you rest a while.

forest.text: A leaning tree shakes a shower of acorns onto your head.

harvest.text: A jar of enchanted honey left on a fence post: sweet relief.

glimmerlake.text: The sunken bell rings under the water, and a drowned purse washes up.

moonwhisper.text: A moonlit witch swaps your voice for a moment; when it comes back, your mind is clear.

thunderstone.text: Storm crystals crackle underfoot: a shock.

sunfall.text: A mirrored oasis: water, shade, and a moment of peace.

frostveil.text: A frozen statue speaks a warning too late: the cold bites.

thornhollow.text: The fae have turned the signposts round; beside the wrong path lies a lost flask.

starfall.text: A falling star rattles your die about.

embercrown.text: A crack in the black rock spits lava: you jump, not quite in time.

shattered.text: A royal mirror repeats your last boast, and something behind it drinks your strength.

streets.text: A baker presses a warm bun on you.
An old soldier shares a story and a sip.
The well water is cold and clear.
A child hands back a coin you dropped.
A washerwoman mends your cloak and shoos you on.
A herb seller lets you breathe in the mint.
